title: Search More, Think Less: Rethinking Long-Horizon Agentic Search for Efficiency and Generalization
selection_reason: SMTL parallelizes evidence acquisition and reports 70.7% fewer reasoning steps on BrowseComp with improved accuracy, directly reducing long-horizon LLM-agent inference work and context pressure.
